facts.value: UL’s one-year, full-time or two-year, part-time Master of Science in Advanced Healthcare Practice is designed to enhance your clinical and academic capabilities to meet new and emerging challenges in healthcare.
Promoting Quality and Safety in Healthcare
advanced capabilities in clinical leadership, service improvement, and evidence-based decision-making—essential for senior roles in healthcare.
Gain hands-on experience in healthcare research through a supervised thesis, enhancing your ability to critically evaluate and contribute to clinical evidence.
Learn alongside professionals from various allied health disciplines, fostering teamwork and broadening your perspective on integrated patient care.
This programme is not open to non-EU students due to Visa/Immigration requirements.
